config.menu.new.desc: Step-by-step assistant for a fresh config file.
config.menu.open.desc: Edit a config file. Coming in a later stage.
config.menu.diff.desc: Compare a file with the live daemon's config. Needs admin enrichment.
config.wiz.title: New configuration
config.saving.title: Saving...
config.saved.ok.title: Saved
config.saved.ok.hint: Press any key to return to the menu. The daemon must be (re)started to pick up the change.
config.saved.fail.title: Save failed
config.saved.fail.hint: Press any key to return to the menu. Open Existing will let you fix the file once that mode lands.
wiz.mode.title: Mode
wiz.mode.desc: Will this daemon run as a tunnel client or a tunnel server?
wiz.transport.title: Transport
wiz.transport.desc: Underlying packet transport. UDP is the default.
wiz.transport.protocol.desc: Custom IP protocol number for raw transport (1..255).
wiz.transport.icmp_mode.desc: Echo on the client, Reply on the server (or the other way round).
wiz.server.address.desc: Hostname or IP of the remote server. DNS is resolved at daemon start.
wiz.spoof.source.desc: Spoofed source IPv4 the daemon writes into outbound packets.
wiz.spoof.peer.desc: IPv4 the peer uses as its spoofed source. Optional on UDP transport.
wiz.spoof.client_real.desc: Server-side only: the real address to send reply traffic back to.
wiz.crypto.title: Crypto
wiz.crypto.desc: Generate a fresh X25519 keypair or paste existing keys.
wiz.crypto.paste: Paste an existing private + peer public
wiz.crypto.generated_pub: Public key (share this with the peer):
wiz.crypto.share_with_peer: The private key is kept locally and embedded in the saved config.
wiz.crypto.peer_pub.desc: Base64-encoded X25519 public key produced on the peer side.
wiz.crypto.private.desc: Base64-encoded X25519 private key. Generated by `quiccochet keygen`.
wiz.inbound.title: Local listener (inbound)
wiz.inbound.desc: What should the daemon listen for locally? Apps connect here and traffic flows through the tunnel.
wiz.inbound.forward: TCP forward to a single target
wiz.inbound.listen.desc: host:port to bind. Use 127.0.0.1:1080 for a SOCKS5 on loopback.
wiz.inbound.target.desc: host:port the daemon will forward connections to (forward mode only).
wiz.adv.toggle.title: Configure advanced settings?
wiz.adv.toggle.desc: MTU, obfuscation, log level, admin socket, metrics. Defaults are fine for most setups.
wiz.adv.mtu.desc: On-wire packet size budget in bytes (1231..1500). Default 1400.
wiz.adv.obf.mode.desc: none = no padding; standard = padding; paranoid = padding + chaff.
wiz.adv.obf.chaff.desc: Idle-fill interval for paranoid mode. 50 ms is a sensible default.
wiz.adv.log.level.desc: info covers normal operation; debug is verbose.
wiz.adv.security.block_private.desc: Refuse to dial RFC1918/ULA/link-local addresses. Recommended on for internet exposure.
wiz.adv.admin.socket.desc: Unix-socket path for live stats. Empty disables. Example: /run/quiccochet/admin.sock
wiz.adv.metrics.listen.desc: Prometheus /metrics endpoint host:port. Empty disables. Example: 127.0.0.1:9200
wiz.review.title: Review
